properties.message_511: On I-95 at mile marker 75.3 in Richmond City, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The south right shoulder is closed.
On Rt. 650 in Fairfax County, in the vicinity of Ramp to Rte 495; Rte 650 Rmp 2B, motorists can expect delays due to a tractor trailer crash. The north exit ramp is closed.
